objective: Repair two non-blocking review notes on the Windows fixes: keep hook-time state-lock waits inside the 10s plugin hook timeout, and make the brokenGit hooks-test assertion locale-independent.
scope: Branch release/0.2.0/fix/windows-tests, checked out in /home/user/holyagent (head b319468). Review range was e7eb9b4..b319468.

Note 1: packages/runtime/src/state/lock.ts now waits up to 30s (polling every 25ms) on a live lock holder. Plugin hooks run under a 10s timeout (packages/integrations/claude/dist/hooks/hooks.json, source under packages/integrations/claude/src). The agent-launch hook (packages/runtime/src/cli/hook.ts around line 337) calls updateState, so a hook waiting on a busy lock can be killed by the hook timeout instead of failing cleanly with StateLocked. Make hook-time state updates use a patience that ends well inside the hook timeout (for example a hook-specific limit of a few seconds), keeping the 30s default for CLI commands, which Windows CI needs. Use the existing lock options rather than a new mechanism.

Note 4: packages/integrations/claude/tests/hooks.test.ts around line 1714 (brokenGit) asserts the English git message 'bad config line', which fails under a localized git. Run that git with LC_ALL=C (and LANGUAGE unset or C) in the test so the assertion holds in any locale.
